svg.desc: A dynamic batcher. Clients put requests with a future on a queue; the batcher closes a batch when it holds 32 items or 2 milliseconds have passed since the first one, runs the model once on the batch, and splits the results so each caller receives its own answer. A timeline shows five requests collected within one max-wait window and later arrivals starting the next batch.

svg.text: Collect requests until the batch is full or the first one has waited long enough.

svg.text: Under light load the wait is pure added latency; under heavy load batches fill instantly.

svg.text: Set max_wait to a small fraction of the latency SLO; set max_batch to what the hardware runs within the SLO.
